paragraphs.text: A prequel novel to the original iteration of the Magic: The Gathering Netflix series was announced on August 24, 2021. It was written by acclaimed fantasy author Django Wexler .

Though originally planned for release in 2022 , the eventual release of this novel has become uncertain because the premise of the Netflix series has been profoundly changed with a shift of the protagonist to Chandra Nalaar .

Expanding on the events that would have unfolded in the Netflix series as initially envisioned, the prequel novel would dive into how Gideon Jura and Jace Beleren bonded — and distanced — as they shared causes, but had distinct perspectives and abilities.
